checks_passed.description: Whether every pre-installation check of the manifest passed (the game copies are the expected ones).

contract.description: Always `ttwright-result`: a reader refuses a document that names another Contract.

dry_run.description: A dry run reads everything and writes nothing.

log_file.description: The log file of the run, when one was written.

messages.description: Up to twenty lines on what went wrong in detail (a failed asset, a failed check).

package.description: The package, once its manifest was read.

post_install.description: Post-installation commands (rename, delete) and file times.

resumed.description: Whether this run continued an interrupted one.

tool.description: The tool that printed this document.

Counts.description: Done and failed counts of one kind of work.

resumed.description: Items done by an earlier, interrupted run and kept (`--resume`).

ErrorCode.description: Why a run did not succeed.

oneOf.description: The arguments are wrong (exit code 2).
The MPI package path does not exist.
The MPI package cannot be read: not an archive, or truncated.
The package has no manifest (`_package/index.json`).
The manifest is not valid JSON or does not have the manifest's shape.
The manifest uses a feature this build does not implement; `feature` names it. Nothing was written.
The package is a TTW version this build does not support; `feature` names the version.
The manifest needs a game copy that was not given (`--fo3`, `--fnv`, `--oblivion`); `feature` names it.
A game copy that was given does not exist or is not that game.
A pre-installation check of the manifest failed (missing or modified game file, too little space).
One or more asset operations failed.
One or more archives (BSA) could not be written.
A post-installation command failed.

`--resume` was asked, but the journal in the destination belongs to another package or another set of
game copies.
The run was cancelled; `--resume` continues it.
A file could not be read or written.
A fault in ttwright itself.

ErrorInfo.description: Why the run did not succeed.

code.description: The stable code callers match on.

feature.description:
For `unsupported_feature`, `unsupported_version` and `game_path_missing`: what is missing, for example
`asset_op:3` or `variable:%XYZ%`.

message.description: Prose for people; never matched on.

PackageInfo.description: The package that was installed, from its manifest.

supported.description: Whether this build lists the package and version as supported (`ttwright contracts --json`).

version.description: The manifest's version, as written there.

oneOf.description: Installed; exit code 0.
Failed; exit code 1 (2 for a usage error).
The package needs a feature or is a version this build does not support; exit code 3. Nothing was written.
Cancelled; exit code 4. `--resume` continues from the journal.

ToolInfo.description: The tool that printed a document.
